scope: Native/browser/VS Code client session visibility across native backend restart

coverage.backend: Actual xMind native server with xlang3-backed SQLite persistence
coverage.browser: Production local browser adapter and BackendClient history route
coverage.vscode: The VS Code extension's production BackendClient pointed at the same native server
coverage.scenario: One persisted session was read through both client paths after restarting the native backend process.
coverage.assertion: Browser and VS Code BackendClient history responses exactly matched the saved native session history; the run remained singular and was not replayed.

limits: The coding/model interaction was not repeated in this contract; separate live acceptance records cover one coding task in each client.
This is client-to-backend integration evidence, not a rendered screenshot or live inspection of the same session in both UI surfaces.

current_checkout_rerun.result: passed against the rebuilt native executable and current local_view_contract.mjs
